title: Letzte Generation Vienna weekday action wave and February follow-up; physical continuity unverified
possible_unit_owner: austria_2023-02 for the distinct 2023-02-13 action; January dates remain in austria_2023-01

reported_january_action_window.summary: Kurier reports Letzte Generation actions on each weekday from 9 through 13 January; the account does not establish uninterrupted physical assembly.

later_followup_plan.summary: A 25 January report says a further wave was planned to begin 13 February at Naschmarkt; requests to participate were not turnout.

later_followup_execution.summary: A 13 February event-day report confirms a later action at Naschmarkt/Getreidemarkt, with about 15 Letzte Generation participants and seven supporting “Omas gegen Rechts”; this later action is distinct and below the 50-person threshold.

physical_episode_boundary.summary: The sources show reported recurrence and a later executed action, not a continuously occupied site or a single uninterrupted assembly. Exact January end and December-to-January continuity remain unknown.

notes: This is cross-month campaign context for coordinator handoff, not a claim that January and February are one continuous public assembly. The February action is separately reported and approximately 22 supporters/activists are below 50; do not add it to January turnout or treat it as a January candidate.
